site.description: Target website domain or URL audited

audited_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of audit execution

confidence.description: How sure this finding is real, distinct from severity (how bad it'd be if true). Defaults to 1.0 (full weight, full certainty).

coverage_blocked.description: True when the AI-bot identity's fetch was blocked, soft-blocked, or challenged by live security infrastructure (WAF/CDN) rather than by robots.txt -- see the critical crawl_access finding this triggers. When true, findings for the categories in categories_not_audited were deliberately not generated, since they would otherwise be built from a browser-identity or headless-rendered view of pages a real AI crawler never reaches.

categories_not_audited.description: Category names whose findings were skipped entirely because coverage_blocked is true (crawl_render, readability, engagement -- all derived from this site's own fetched/rendered HTML). Zero findings there reflects 'not evaluated', not 'verified clean'. freshness_corroboration is deliberately never listed here: its citation_consistency/entity_disambiguation checks corroborate via external web search, not this site's blocked fetch, and keep running even when coverage_blocked -- only its content_dates/temporal_decay sub-checks are skipped.
